seededViolationCases.case: fresh Claude fixture install writes SessionStart + PreToolUse hook entries and verify returns all green

seededViolationCases.case: missing hook rows are failed checks, not silent skips
seededViolationCases.expectation: verify() returns present `sessionstart-hook-present` and `pretooluse-hook-present` checks with passed:false when ~/.claude.json has the MCP registration and descriptor but lacks the hooks map entries

seededViolationCases.case: empty-home round trip removes empty hook and mcp scaffolding on uninstall

seededViolationCases.case: descriptor-specific failures remain isolated from hook verification
